entities.name: Paging indication
entities.description: A network-initiated message used to page a UE for incoming communication or signaling.

entities.name: UE attached for access to RLOS
entities.description: Condition where the UE is attached specifically for access to RLOS (Restricted Local Operator Services).

entities.name: Ongoing UE-initiated EMM specific procedure or service request procedure
entities.description: Condition where the UE is currently executing a UE-initiated EMM specific procedure or service request procedure.

entities.name: Ignore paging indication
entities.description: Behavior where the UE disregards a received paging indication from the network under specific abnormal conditions.

relations.description: Condition where UE is attached for RLOS access establishes the behavior to ignore paging.
Condition of ongoing UE-initiated EMM procedure or service request establishes the behavior to ignore paging.
Paging indication is guarded by the ignore behavior under abnormal conditions.
